bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 169, Number 54 (Friday, March 24, 2023)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mrs. MILLER-MEEKS:
H.R. 1790.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
The Congress shall have power to lay and collect taxes,
duties, imposts and excises, to pay the debts and provide for
the common defense and general welfare of the United States;
but all duties, imposts and excises shall be uniform
throughout the United States;
The single subject of this legislation is:
Study to determine whether there are impediments to the
approval process for interchangeable biologics.
[Page H1438]
